result.instructions: Tools for EZRentOut, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which rental assets are overdue right now, and who has them?"; "Show every order that is currently rented out."; "Which assets are available next week?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes EZRentOut data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ezrentout_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ezrentout_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ezrentout_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. ezrentout_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ezrentout_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List all rental orders (25 per page) with status, customer and dates. Paged: add 1 to page for the next one. GET /baskets.api.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Replies include the total number of pages; ask for the next page by adding 1.

tools.name: ezrentout_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: One order by its order number: customer, status, dates, line items (order_line_items), sub-rent items, totals and payments. GET /baskets/<ORDER#>.api.

tools.name: ezrentout_get_order_history
tools.title: Get an order's in/out history
tools.description: The check-out / check-in history of one order. GET /baskets/<ORDER#>/history.api.

tools.name: ezrentout_list_payment_options
tools.title: List payment options
tools.description: The payment options (cash, check, ...) that ezrentout_record_order_payment accepts. GET /payment_options.api.

tools.name: ezrentout_list_coupons
tools.title: List coupons
tools.description: All pricing coupons of the company. GET /pricing_coupons.api.

tools.name: ezrentout_list_customers
tools.title: List or filter customers
tools.description: List customers (25 per page). Optional filter: email, category, taxed, non_taxed, inactive_customers, subscribed_emails, not_subscribed_emails, checked_out_orders, completed_orders, account_name. email, category, account_name and completed_orders (for example "> 50") need filter_val. GET /customers.api.

filter_val.description: The value for the filters that need one (an email address, a category, an account name, or a comparison such as > 50).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Replies include the total number of pages; ask for the next page by adding 1.

tools.name: ezrentout_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: One customer by id: name, email, phone, addresses, status, custom fields. GET /customers/<CUSTOMER_ID>.api.

tools.name: ezrentout_search_member_by_email
tools.title: Find a customer or contact by email
tools.description: Look up the customer, business contact or business that has an email address. GET /api/members/search_by_email.api.

annotations.title: Find a customer or contact by email

filter_val.description: The comparison for completed_orders, for example > 50.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Replies include the total number of pages; ask for the next page by adding 1.

tools.name: ezrentout_get_business
tools.title: Get a business
tools.description: One business customer by id. GET /businesses/<BUSINESS#>.api.

tools.name: ezrentout_list_business_contacts

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Replies include the total number of pages; ask for the next page by adding 1.

tools.name: ezrentout_get_business_contact

tools.name: ezrentout_list_customer_addresses

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Replies include the total number of pages; ask for the next page by adding 1.

tools.name: ezrentout_list_business_addresses
tools.title: List a business's addresses

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Replies include the total number of pages; ask for the next page by adding 1.

tools.name: ezrentout_list_assets
tools.title: List assets
tools.description: List fixed assets (the individually tracked rental items, 25 per page) with group, location and status. GET /assets.api.

include_custom_fields.description: Also return the items' custom fields (default false).

show_image_urls.description: Also return document and image links of the items (default false).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Replies include the total number of pages; ask for the next page by adding 1.

tools.name: ezrentout_filter_assets
tools.title: Filter assets by status
tools.description: Assets by a status filter. status: available, assets_being_serviced, availability_range, checked_out (= currently rented out), group, location, overdue, possessions_of, possessions_of_email, reserved, product_model_number, items_in_order, reservation_starting_today, retired, update_time. Most filters need filter_param_val (a group or location id, a user id, an email, a model number, an order number; for availability_range two dates joined by ~). Not needed for available, checked_out, overdue, reserved, retired. GET /assets/filter.api.

filter_param_val.description: The value the filter needs, if any.

include_custom_fields.description: Also return the items' custom fields (default false).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Replies include the total number of pages; ask for the next page by adding 1.

tools.name: ezrentout_search_assets
tools.title: Search assets
tools.description: Search by asset name (3+ characters), or # followed by the item number, or @ followed by the identification number. GET /search.api (facet FixedAsset).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Replies include the total number of pages; ask for the next page by adding 1.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Replies include the total number of pages; ask for the next page by adding 1.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Replies include the total number of pages; ask for the next page by adding 1.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Replies include the total number of pages; ask for the next page by adding 1.

tools.title: List bundles
tools.description: Bundles (items rented together, 25 per page). GET /bundles.api.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Replies include the total number of pages; ask for the next page by adding 1.

tools.name: ezrentout_list_vendors
tools.title: List vendors

tools.name: ezrentout_list_work_orders
tools.title: List work orders
tools.description: Maintenance work orders (25 per page), optionally by status filter (open, in_progess [sic, as the vendor spells it], review_pending, complete) or by work order type. GET /tasks.api.

filter.description: A status filter: open, in_progess, review_pending or complete.

task_type.description: A work order type name, from ezrentout_list_work_order_types.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Replies include the total number of pages; ask for the next page by adding 1.

tools.name: ezrentout_get_work_order
tools.title: Get a work order
tools.description: One work order by number. GET /tasks/<Work_Order#>.api.

tools.name: ezrentout_list_work_order_types
tools.title: List work order types
tools.description: The work order types of the company. GET /task_types.api.

tools.name: ezrentout_list_custom_reports
tools.title: List saved reports

tools.name: ezrentout_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer (a person who rents). First and last name are required. Does not create an order. POST /customers.api.

tools.name: ezrentout_create_order
tools.title: Create an order
tools.description: Create a new rental order (a draft until it is booked or rented out) for a customer, optionally with assets and dates. If the customer belongs to several businesses, pass business_id. Does not rent anything out and does not charge. POST /baskets.api.

customer_id.description: The customer or business-contact id, from ezrentout_list_customers.

business_id.description: The business, when the contact is part of several.

asset_numbers.description: Assets to add (asset numbers; a bundle as <id>-b).

tools.name: ezrentout_add_assets_to_order
tools.title: Add assets to an order
tools.description: Add assets (or bundles as <id>-b) to an existing order. PATCH /baskets/<ORDER#>/update_basket_from_show.api.

asset_numbers.description: Asset numbers; a bundle as <bundle id>-b, e.g. 12, 25-b.

tools.name: ezrentout_book_order
tools.title: Book an order
tools.description: Reserve an order's assets for a period (books the order). EZRentOut may notify the customer according to the account's settings. PATCH /baskets/<ORDER#>/reservation.api.

tools.name: ezrentout_add_order_custom_entry
tools.title: Add a custom charge to an order
tools.description: Add a custom line (a named amount, for example a delivery fee) to an order; it raises the order total. Not possible on sold, void, completed or cancelled orders. POST /baskets/<ORDER#>/custom_entries.api.

amount.description: The amount, in the account's currency.

tax_free.description: true = no tax on this charge.

annotations.title: Add a custom charge to an order

tools.name: ezrentout_record_order_payment
tools.title: Record a payment on an order
tools.description: Record a payment received for an order (a prepayment). It records the amount in EZRentOut; it does not charge a card (credit card payments are not supported by the API). Use a payment_method_name from ezrentout_list_payment_options. PATCH /baskets/<ORDER#>/charge_pre_payment.api.

payment_method_name.description: A payment option name, for example Cash.

annotations.title: Record a payment on an order

tools.name: ezrentout_rent_out_order
tools.title: Rent out an order (check out)
tools.description: Check an order out: its assets go to the customer and the rental clock and billing start. EZRentOut may email the customer according to the account's settings. Give rentout_date and return_date, or use_current_datetime. PATCH /baskets/<ORDER#>/checkout.api.

tools.name: ezrentout_return_order
tools.title: Return an order (check in)
tools.description: Check an order in: the customer returned the assets, rental billing ends and the assets become available again. Give return_date (and return_time), or use_current_datetime to return now. Returns the whole order (no partial returns, late fees or payment here; use ezrentout_record_order_payment). EZRentOut may email the customer according to the account's settings. PATCH /baskets/<ORDER#>/checkin.api.

tools.name: ezrentout_add_asset_comment
tools.title: Add a comment to an item
tools.description: Add a comment to an asset, asset stock or inventory item. POST /assets/<ASSET#>/comments.api.

created_by_id.description: The user the comment is attributed to.

annotations.title: Add a comment to an item

tools.name: ezrentout_create_work_order
tools.title: Create a maintenance work order
tools.description: Create a work order with a title, type and due date, optionally for assets. By default the linked assets are marked unavailable (mark_items_unavailable). POST /tasks.api.

task_type.description: The work order type name, from ezrentout_list_work_order_types.

asset_numbers.description: Assets the work order is for.

mark_items_unavailable.description: Default true in EZRentOut: the assets cannot be rented while the work order is open.

tools.name: ezrentout_start_work_order
tools.title: Start a work order
tools.description: Mark a work order in progress. PATCH /tasks/<Work_Order#>/mark_in_progress.api.

tools.name: ezrentout_complete_work_order
tools.title: Complete a work order
tools.description: Mark a work order complete; its assets may become available again. PATCH /tasks/<Work_Order#>/mark_complete.api.
